title: An unused term of the shop's own shows every item, Delete last in red
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-09 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Hover "Move Customers".
  3. Hover "Deactivate".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu shows exactly these items, in this order: "Edit" (pencil), "Make Default for New Customers" (circle check), "Move Customers" (person, greyed out), "Deactivate" (archive), "Delete Credit Term" (trash, in red, below a divider). Nothing else shows.
  • Step 2: the hover reads "No customers are on this term".
  • Step 3: the hover reads "Hide from customer and vendor pickers".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions), story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S2-R1: “Each row's "⋯" menu shows only the items that apply to that term, in this order. An item that applies but is blocked shows greyed out and does nothing when clicked; hovering it shows the reason.”
  • S2-R1 table, header row: “Item (icon) | Shown on | Blocked when (hover text)”
  • S2-R1 table, Edit row: “"Edit" (pencil) | Active terms the shop created | The term is in use: "Used by {holders}" with "Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers." below”
  • S2-R1 table, Delete Credit Term row: “"Delete Credit Term" (trash, red, last, below a divider) | Terms the shop created, active or inactive | The term is the default: "This is your default for new customers" / "Pick another default first."; otherwise the term is in use: "Used by {holders}" / "Deactivate it instead to take it out of the pickers."”
  • S4-N2: “If no customer is on the term, "Move Customers" shows greyed with the hover text "No customers are on this term".”
  • Key Decisions: “Once a term is in use (by any customer, vendor or invoice), its name and days are locked; it can be deactivated but not deleted. An unused term can be edited or deleted.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover a blocked Move Customers | "No customers are on this term" | Tooltip on hover, item greyed”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "1 List and row menus" ("Row menu: your term, not used yet"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p1-04-row-menu-your-term-not-used-yet.png

The design's own words:

  • “Rendered from the local build: Net 6 (the shop's own, no customers or vendors). Edit, Make Default for New Customers, Move Customers greyed (no customers), Deactivate, then Delete Credit Term in red after a divider.”
  • “The menu is as wide as its items.”
